channel.title: Pier & Point · Verde
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Verde (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Verde: On the Verde timeline, the April 2024 leasing launch and the June 2024…
item.description: On the Verde timeline, the April 2024 leasing launch and the June 2024 move-ins used to appear twice, from two tables with different wording; each now appears once. Dates and statuses are unchanged and no source was dropped. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Correction · Verde: One routine building permit (alterations, revisions, deferred submittals, fire…
item.description: One routine building permit (alterations, revisions, deferred submittals, fire or utility work and similar) now appears under Building permits in this record's research notes instead of on its timeline. One permit cost figure now shows as the valuation of the matching permit entry under Building permits, not under Costs. Earlier change-log entries about these permits stay in the log until it is archived at launch. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Correction · Verde: The Verde page now describes Mitsui Fudosan America as joining Mission Rock…
item.description: The Verde page now describes Mitsui Fudosan America as joining Mission Rock Partners, dates the Port's topping-out report to its October 2023 memo, quotes the press report that the building 'has been open to new residents since June' next to the Port's later 'seven months into lease-up' remark, lists 330,000 sq ft among the conflicting size figures, and says LEED Gold is a target. The TCO dates are Port projections; no document read gives the date it was issued. Source: https://www.sfport.com/files/2023-10/101023_8b_mission_rock_budget_port_capital_parcel_lease_amendment_final.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Verde: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ')
item.description: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ'); the disputes, quoted excerpts and hedging moved to this record's open questions, with every source still named. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · Verde: Verde's summary now gives the opening date Chipotle's own page states (Sept.…
item.description: Verde's summary now gives the opening date Chipotle's own page states (Sep 23, 2026), not a confirmed opening. Source: https://locations.chipotle.com/ca/san-francisco/365-toni-stone-xing.

item.title: Correction · Verde: BVNK was listed as an open tenant at Verde, but the only evidence was a…
item.description: BVNK was listed as an open tenant at Verde, but the only evidence was a business registration from March 2025. A registration does not show an office opened, and no source naming BVNK at Mission Rock was found, so it is removed from the tenant list. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis.

item.title: Status · Verde: Chipotle's own page for its Mission Rock restaurant (365 Toni Stone Xing, Unit C)…
item.description: Chipotle's own page for its Mission Rock restaurant (365 Toni Stone Xing, Unit C) gives an open date of September 23, 2026, with daily hours and online ordering, in data timestamped September 24, 2026. The restaurant was previously shown as announced, on a December 2025 post that expected a 2026 opening. The date is the company's own statement; no news report of the opening was found. Source: https://locations.chipotle.com/ca/san-francisco/365-toni-stone-xing.

item.title: Correction · Verde: Verde's page now shows the $75.6 million jobs-housing fee subsidy as the…
item.description: Verde's page now shows the $75.6 million jobs-housing fee subsidy as the Port's planned 2019 minimum, not an amount received. The two loan amounts (Wells Fargo and Ares Management) are marked unconfirmed because the only article reporting them could not be read. Only Arsicault Bakery is listed for Verde's ground floor, and the Parcel F swap is dated to the April 2019 submittal. Source: Port Commission Item 7A, 2019-09-24 (sfport.com Item 7A Mission Rock Phase 1 Budget Approval); Mission Rock Partners Phase 1 Overview, submitted 7/2/2019 (Port Item 11D Attachment 1); SF YIMBY, 2024-09-04; Mission Rock release via MFA, 2024-04-30.
item.source: Port Commission Item 7A, 2019-09-24 (sfport.com Item 7A Mission Rock Phase 1 Budget Approval); Mission Rock Partners Phase 1 Overview, submitted 7/2/2019 (Port Item 11D Attachment 1); SF YIMBY, 2024-09-04; Mission Rock release via MFA, 2024-04-30

item.title: Correction · Verde: Arsicault Bakery's tenant listing now also cites the bakery's own live…
item.description: Arsicault Bakery's tenant listing now also cites the bakery's own live locations page, read October 6, 2026; its earlier source was a March 2025 release. Source: https://www.arsicault-bakery.com/locations/.

item.title: Correction · Verde: Verde's record now states: leasing was announced on April 23, 2024 (two days…
item.description: Verde's record now states: leasing was announced on April 23, 2024 (two days before the April 25 park opening), not April 24; the unit mix is shown both ways (SF YIMBY 30/129/91/4 and the Port's March 2025 table 30/132/88/4); the 'started early' paraphrase is replaced by the Port's own stated reason; the four-corner intersection no longer names streets the source does not; Verde's status and June 2024 opening now cite the September 2024 SF YIMBY article instead of an April article that only said it was scheduled; Arsicault's opening date is blank because the March 11, 2025 release gives no day; a mistaken Ike's address on Verde's photo was removed; the BVNK registration is described as a registration; source titles and dates for the Yield Pro repost, the SF Examiner article, the Design Controls credit and the Port disclosure report were corrected; and the Jan 30, 2018 approval now cites the Port Commission minutes. Source: SF YIMBY, 2024-04-26 (https://sfyimby.com/2024/04/mision-rock-opens-waterfront-park-starts-leasing-for-verde-san-francisco.html); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 12A staff report, 2025-03-07 (https://sfport.com/media/10228/download?inline=031125_12a_mission_rock_revised_phase_1_submittal_-_info_and_possible_action.pdf); SF YIMBY, 2024-09-04 (https://sfyimby.com/2024/09/ribbon-cutting-for-23-story-verde-in-mission-rock-san-francisco.html); Mission Rock Partners release via citybiz, 2025-03-11 (https://www.citybiz.co/article/670677/celebrated-san-francisco-bakery-arsicault-opens-new-location-in-mission-rock-neighborhood/); Port of San Francisco, Minutes of the Special Port Commission Meeting, 2018-01-30 (https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download).
item.source: SF YIMBY, 2024-04-26 (https://sfyimby.com/2024/04/mision-rock-opens-waterfront-park-starts-leasing-for-verde-san-francisco.html); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 12A staff report, 2025-03-07 (https://sfport.com/media/10228/download?inline=031125_12a_mission_rock_revised_phase_1_submittal_-_info_and_possible_action.pdf); SF YIMBY, 2024-09-04 (https://sfyimby.com/2024/09/ribbon-cutting-for-23-story-verde-in-mission-rock-san-francisco.html); Mission Rock Partners release via citybiz, 2025-03-11 (https://www.citybiz.co/article/670677/celebrated-san-francisco-bakery-arsicault-opens-new-location-in-mission-rock-neighborhood/); Port of San Francisco, Minutes of the Special Port Commission Meeting, 2018-01-30 (https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download)

item.title: Correction · Verde: A building permit inside the record's own construction window stays on the…
item.description: A building permit inside the record's own construction window stays on the timeline, but its cost is now listed as a permit valuation rather than a construction cost and is left out of cost totals, like a financing entry. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Added · Verde: BVNK registered a business location at 365 Toni Stone Xing in March 2025
item.description: BVNK registered a business location at 365 Toni Stone Xing in March 2025. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis.

item.title: Correction · Verde: Same change as for Parcel G: the shared Mission Rock Phase 1 figures now…
item.description: Same change as for Parcel G: the shared Mission Rock Phase 1 figures now appear once in the shared site-wide cost list. Parcel F's own appraised lease value, jobs-housing fee received, construction loan and refinancing figures stay on its record, now labelled by cost type (land/lease, fee/subsidy, and financing for the two loans) and as specific to this parcel; the two loans are marked as financing so they are never added to a development total. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Added · Verde: Arsicault Bakery, known for its croissants, had opened its third location by March…
item.description: Arsicault Bakery, known for its croissants, had opened its third location by March 11, 2025 (the date of Mission Rock Partners' release) at 1070 Bridgeview Way, in the Verde residential tower at Mission Rock (unit B per DataSF business registrations); the release gives no opening day. Source: https://www.citybiz.co/article/670677/celebrated-san-francisco-bakery-arsicault-opens-new-location-in-mission-rock-neighborhood/.

item.title: Added · Verde: A Mapillary street-level frame showing Ike's Love & Sandwiches' storefront signage…
item.description: A Mapillary street-level frame showing Ike's Love & Sandwiches' storefront signage was added to Verde's record. Ike's is at 1090 Dr. Maya Angelou Lane, Unit G (GlobeNewswire, June 17, 2024), an address listed on the Building B record, not Verde; the photo was later removed (see the next entry). Source: GlobeNewswire, 2024-06-17 (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2024/06/17/2900025/0/en/IKE-S-LOVE-SANDWICHES-RETURNS-TO-SF-ROOTS-FOR-ITS-100TH-LOCATION.html).

item.title: Correction · Verde: Verde's Ike's Love & Sandwiches storefront photo un-hosted on a second look…
item.description: Verde's Ike's Love & Sandwiches storefront photo un-hosted on a second look: clutter in the frame didn't hold up next to other photos. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Correction · Verde: Verde's record now names its block: Parcel F (the Port's April 2024 and March…
item.description: Verde's record now names its block: Parcel F (the Port's April 2024 and March 2025 memos discuss 'Verde' under Parcel F, and SF YIMBY tags it 'Mission Rock Parcel F'). It had earlier been listed as Block A, which is The Canyon (SF YIMBY 2022: 'The Canyon at Parcel A'). Source: Port Commission memo 2025-03-07 (Item 12A); SF YIMBY 2022-03-07; SF YIMBY 2024-04-26.
item.source: Port Commission memo 2025-03-07 (Item 12A); SF YIMBY 2022-03-07; SF YIMBY 2024-04-26

item.title: Milestone · Verde: Commercial Property Executive (article dated July 14, 2026) is the… (~Jul 2026)
item.description: Commercial Property Executive (article dated July 14, 2026) is the only source for a $117.8M loan from Ares Management, described there as refinancing the earlier construction loan; the article could not be read when this record was checked, so the amount, lender and what it replaced are unconfirmed, and the month shown is the article's publication month, not a closing date (~Jul 2026). Source: Commercial Property Executive, 2026-07-14.

item.title: Milestone · Verde: Leasing status: 36 of 59 BMR units (61%) and 98 of 195 market-rate… (Feb 2025)
item.description: Leasing status: 36 of 59 BMR units (61%) and 98 of 195 market-rate units (50%) leased (Feb 2025). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-07.

item.title: Milestone · Verde: Ribbon cutting with Mayor London Breed (Sep 3, 2024)
item.description: Ribbon cutting with Mayor London Breed; about 20% of units leased at that point (Sep 3, 2024). Source: SF YIMBY, 2024-09-04; San Francisco Examiner, 2024-09-04.

item.title: Complete · Verde: Residents begin moving in (SF YIMBY, September 4, 2024: "the… (~Jun 2024)
item.description: Residents begin moving in (SF YIMBY, September 4, 2024: "the building has been open to new residents since June"; the Port's April 2024 memo had forecast move-ins in June 2024, and its March 2025 memo says "As of February 2025, seven months into lease-up", which would put lease-up from about July 2024) (~Jun 2024). Source: SF YIMBY, 2024-09-04; Port of San Francisco, 2024-04-05.
item.source: SF YIMBY, 2024-09-04; Port of San Francisco, 2024-04-05

item.title: Milestone · Verde: Leasing launch announced (SF YIMBY: two days before the April… (Apr 23, 2024)
item.description: Leasing launch announced (SF YIMBY: two days before the April 25, 2024 China Basin Park opening next door) (Apr 23, 2024). Source: SF YIMBY, 2024-04-26; Yield Pro (trade-press article reposted on Mitsui Fudosan America's press page), 2024-04-30.
item.source: SF YIMBY, 2024-04-26; Yield Pro (trade-press article reposted on Mitsui Fudosan America's press page), 2024-04-30

item.title: Milestone · Verde: Port Commission (Resolution 24-21) approves re-mixing Parcel F's… (Apr 9, 2024)
item.description: Port Commission (Resolution 24-21) approves re-mixing Parcel F's BMR units from 97 (38%) to 59 (23%): 35 at 90% AMI, 24 at 120% AMI, none at 150% (Apr 9, 2024). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2024-04-05; Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-07.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2024-04-05; Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-07

item.title: Milestone · Verde: The Port's October 6, 2023 memo reports Building F's structural… (~Oct 2023)
item.description: The Port's October 6, 2023 memo reports Building F's structural elements as topped out (the topping-out date itself is not given) (~Oct 2023). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06.

item.title: Under construction · Verde: Construction starts (the Port says it started in March 2022… (Mar 2022)
item.description: Construction starts (the Port says it started in March 2022 'due to the unique financial structure of the project, including the payment of Jobs Housing Equivalency Fees by the office projects to subsidize the below-market rate housing') (Mar 2022). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06.

item.title: Milestone · Verde: Commercial Property Executive (article dated July 14, 2026) is the only… (~2022)
item.description: Commercial Property Executive (article dated July 14, 2026) is the only source for a $116.2M construction loan from Wells Fargo originated in 2022; the article could not be read when this record was checked, so the amount, lender and year are unconfirmed (~2022). item.description: DBI site permit 201910073784 for new construction of Building F (23 stories, 258 residential units with retail, office, restaurant and assembly) approved; filed October 7, 2019 (Oct 26, 2020). Source: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection; DBI (Building Permits).

item.description: Port executes the 75-year prepaid Parcel F lease (Lease No. L-16706) with Mission Rock Parcel F Owner, L.L.C.; memorandum recorded October 7, 2020 (Oct 6, 2020). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2024-04-05; Port of San Francisco, 2019-09-24.

item.description: Port Commission approves the Phase 1 budget with Parcel F in the phase (Resolution 19-39) (Sep 24, 2019). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2019-09-24.

item.title: Milestone · Verde: The developer's Phase 1 Phase Submittal proposes swapping Parcel F… (~Apr 2019)
item.description: The developer's Phase 1 Phase Submittal proposes swapping Parcel F into Phase 1 in place of Parcel K, adding roughly 100 units (about 40 affordable) and a four-sided intersection instead of a linear street alignment. The Port's resolution says the Phase Submittal with this boundary change was submitted on April 4, 2019; the developer's Phase 1 overview (a document dated July 2, 2019) says the submittal was submitted on December 4, 2018 and revised on April 24, 2019, and describes the swap in the past tense without dating it (~Apr 2019). Source: Mission Rock Partners (developer's submittal to the Port), 2019-07-02; Port of San Francisco, 2019-09-24.
item.source: Mission Rock Partners (developer's submittal to the Port), 2019-07-02; Port of San Francisco, 2019-09-24
